platform_rule: Azure provides the execution platform. COBIT-Chain provides the assurance overlay.
positioning: Platform A remains Azure-first. Platform B remains cloud-neutral. This enhancement treats prompt governance, model abstraction, and the full AI lifecycle as governed objects within the existing Platform A architecture.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Define AI use case, context of use, user workflow, risk class, agent boundary, data sources, and expected outcome.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Establish governed intent, context validation, workflow ownership, evidence requirements, and inspection-ready design basis.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Configure prompts, agents, model abstraction, tools, retrieval layer, MCP connections, and application workflow.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Apply prompt governance, model abstraction governance, tool-call boundary, evidence lineage, and agent identity controls.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Evaluate output quality, groundedness, safety, hallucination risk, workflow fit, and operational decision usefulness.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Convert evaluation outputs into Decision Confidence, evidence package quality, model trust, prompt trust, and limitation records.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Apply governance policies, access controls, change control, audit settings, knowledge controls, and operational guardrails.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Validate policy compliance, access boundary, change impact, knowledge source trust, approval requirement, and inspection readiness.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Route AI capability, prompt changes, model selection, tool use, and deployment package through human approval gates.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Require named accountable review, approval rationale, exception handling, decision integrity, and deployment authorization.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Deploy the AI application, agent workflow, model endpoint, prompt configuration, tools, monitoring, and access controls.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Confirm deployment readiness, change control, rollback readiness, release evidence, operational ownership, and trust-state baseline.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Monitor runtime behavior, traces, performance, quality, safety, usage, drift, tool calls, and operational incidents.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Bind telemetry to Observability, Evidence Vault, tool-call evidence, trust score changes, and operational readiness signals.

lifecycle.foundry_activity: Continuously evaluate trust, update evidence, detect changes, manage prompt/model drift, review outcomes, and improve governance.
lifecycle.cobitchain_assurance_role: Maintain continuous assurance through Evidence Vault, Decision Confidence, Operational Trust Twin, AI ChangeControlTrust, and audit replay.

components.azure_execution_role: Central workspace for enterprise AI development, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Defines the governed AI system boundary, ownership model, operational context, evidence scope, and inspection-ready assurance record.

components.azure_execution_role: Abstracts model selection, model endpoint access, approved models, fallback options, and model-provider implementation details.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Tracks model trust, approved-use boundary, model version, model selection rationale, fallback risk, and regulated workflow limitations.

components.azure_execution_role: Manages system instructions, agent prompts, prompt templates, prompt versions, prompt evaluation, and prompt lifecycle changes.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Controls prompt identity, prompt versioning, prompt approval, prompt change impact, rollback, evaluation evidence, and inspection readiness.

components.azure_execution_role: Manages agent instructions, role, task boundaries, orchestration behavior, tool use, and operational workflow participation.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Applies agent passport requirements, agent identity, action boundaries, human approval gates, and decision traceability.

components.azure_execution_role: Connects AI agents to enterprise knowledge sources, search indexes, retrieval pipelines, documents, and data stores.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluates knowledge source trust, grounding quality, freshness, controlled-source status, source ownership, and evidence lineage.

components.azure_execution_role: Provides controlled tool access for AI agents through governed external tools, APIs, and data services.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Requires tool-call evidence, tool identity, allowed-action boundary, blocked-action logic, replay readiness, and evidence binding.

components.azure_execution_role: Supports human-in-the-loop review, approval, escalation, and oversight in AI-enabled workflows.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Defines approval gates, named accountable reviewer, review evidence, exception handling, and regulated decision boundaries.

components.azure_execution_role: Captures runtime telemetry, evaluations, metrics, drift signals, traces, and operational health indicators.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Maps monitoring to observability, audit replay, trust-score changes, evidence quality, operational readiness, and continuous assurance.

components.azure_execution_role: Provides identity, access control, secrets, policy, monitoring, logging, and governance controls for enterprise AI systems.
components.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluates agent identity, access boundary, privileged action risk, governance control evidence, and inspection readiness.

governed_objects.assurance_question: Is the AI capability being used inside a defined and approved operational context?
Can model selection, model version, model purpose, and limitations be traced and justified?
Can prompt content, version, owner, evaluation, approval, and rollback be evidenced?
Can the agent identity, authority, allowed actions, blocked actions, and escalation rules be verified?
Does evaluation evidence support the intended operational use?
Was a named accountable human required to approve operational use or deployment?
Can deployment be justified, replayed, rolled back, and tied to approved evidence?
Can trust state, drift, outcomes, and changes be continuously monitored and evidenced?
